US Destroys Iranian Tankers; Iran Strikes Jordan Base

The U.S. military announced it destroyed five Iranian oil tankers amid escalating conflict. In retaliation, Iran targeted a U.S. base in Jordan. The U.S. military's action involved striking the tankers, though specific details on the base attack were not provided in the coverage.
